capabilities: Display a character count badge on each code block
Update the count live as you type
Count only visible characters, excluding spaces, tabs and newlines
Support reading view, live preview, and embedded renders including embeds and canvas
extras: Installable via BRAT (beta plugin); bilingual English/Chinese README; no settings.
problem: Obsidian does not display any size indicator for code blocks, so you cannot see how long a block is without selecting and counting its text.
summary: Character count badge that shows the number of visible characters at the bottom-right of every code block in reading view and live preview.
